name: codex-orchestration
description: Old-task-compatible tweak/build routing with visible checkpoint supervision.

interface.shortDescription: Visible tweak/build routing in new or old tasks
interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration in a new or already-open task with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. GPT-5.6 Terra / Max receives the bounded same-task context, preserves unfinished acceptance, and classifies each request as read-only, small tweak, big tweak, small build, or big build. Classification, not a numeric score, selects the route; complexity remains telemetry only. Version 0.8.2 retains the 0.8.0 and 0.8.1 custom-agent identities needed for old-task catalog compatibility and can use pinned built-in fallbacks when an older task has neither catalog, so it never silently substitutes a default model. For change work, root starts the selected implementer and immediately starts a full-context read-only supervisor. Root reports implementation start, supervisor readiness, 45-second waiting heartbeats, checkpoint review, correction, release, and final verification in the parent task. The implementer pauses at quiescent checkpoints, the supervisor inspects without editing, and every correction goes back to the same implementer. Small tweaks use Luna / Max with Terra / Max supervision; big tweaks use Terra / Max with Terra / Max supervision; small builds use Terra / Max with Sol / High supervision; big builds use Sol / High with Sol / Extra High supervision.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat tweak/build routing with checkpoint supervision.
